name: ipinfo
label: ipinfo
description: ipinfo official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: lookup (GET https://api.ipinfo.io/lookup/{ip} Core), lite (GET /lite/{ip} unlimited country/ASN), me (GET /lite/me), batch (POST /batch), lookup_legacy (deprecated GET https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json). Docs: https://ipinfo.io/developers. Bearer token (docs also show ?token= and Basic -u $TOKEN:). Lite is unlimited with a token. Core/lookup is paid. IP lookup can be PII. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One ipinfo request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"lookup"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: lookup | lite | me | batch | lookup_legacy. lookup = Core GET /lookup/{ip}. lite = free GET /lite/{ip}. me = GET /lite/me. lookup_legacy is deprecated (https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json). Default: instance operation. Example: 'lite'.

schema.label: ip
schema.description: IPv4 or IPv6 for lookup / lite / lookup_legacy. Example: 8.8.8.8. me uses the caller address (no ip).

schema.label: ips
schema.description: batch POST /batch whole-body JSON array of IPs (or /<ip>/<field> paths). Wired via bodyMap "$" so the list is the request body. Example: ["8.8.8.8","1.1.1.1"].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: lookup, lite, me, batch, lookup_legacy. lookup = IPinfo Core (paid). lite = IPinfo Lite (unlimited). lookup_legacy is deprecated.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: IPinfo token (https://ipinfo.io/signup). OfficialApiNode auth type `bearer` (Authorization: Bearer). Docs also accept ?token= and Basic -u $TOKEN:. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
